human_reference.disagreement: preserve then third-rater or predeclared consensus adjudication

materiality_routing.ESC: non-tied one-step Overall may be official-score-derived; ties and explicit checks use the qualified pairwise teacher
materiality_routing.QA: non-tied one-step semantic correctness may be official-score-derived; ties and explicit checks use the qualified pairwise teacher
materiality_routing.Summary: directional Event_F1 requires qualified pairwise confirmation until a separately justified natural-unit material margin is frozen
materiality_routing.DG: directional local Weighted_Score requires qualified pairwise correctness/appropriateness confirmation
materiality_routing.unresolved_or_budget_exhausted: uncertain and excluded from supervised likelihood

claude_role: substitute only; never an additive full-sample run
selection_order: human decisive/equivalent macro agreement with clustered uncertainty
weak_teacher_fallback: use only task official primary-anchor identifiable cases; retain ties/conflicts and continuous-magnitude-unresolved cases as uncertain and contract claims
